{{Youmay|the slang term|the [[Jawa Traders|Mos Eisley store]]}}
The slang term '''Jawa trader''' was used by [[Human/Legends|Humans]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] to describe any individual that was dishonest or traded in stolen or damaged merchandise.
